headline: Hotfix: route colours, sweet spot and clearer charts

items.title: Route colours along the line
items.line: The ride map shows the colour changing along the route again, not one shade for the whole ride.

items.title: Speed sweet spot works
items.line: It now finds your steady stretches, so it can start learning your best cruising speed.

items.title: Clearer Stats chart
items.line: Round dashed lines on the bars' own scale, centred wider bars, your best day in red.

items.title: Ride graph
items.line: Pinch sideways for time, up-down for values; tap a chip again for its deeper line; the map shows the part you look at.

full: The ride map and Replay show the colour changing along the route again.
Developer: Route line lab compares three ways of drawing the route.
Speed sweet spot finds steady stretches again (it wanted readings closer together than rides store).
Stats: dashed lines in round steps, the top one about at the tallest bar, on the bars' own scale.
Stats: bars centred on their day, wider with a gap; the tallest is red.
Ride graph: pinch sideways to zoom time, up-down to stretch the values; drag to move along the ride.
Ride graph: tap Speed, Battery or Height again for acceleration, battery per km or incline.
Ride graph: the part of the ride on the graph is orange on the map; Hills jumps to a climb; Select and Scatter are gone.

headline: Rides are never lost, and the map says more

items.title: No more lost rides
items.line: A ride starts when you really ride, stays on while you ride, and is kept even if the phone took over.

items.title: Where to? from anywhere
items.line: Pick your destination from the Scooter on notification, or change it at a stop.

items.title: Ride map layers
items.line: Speed, Hills, Wind, Battery and Temp on one smooth line; tap a layer again for a deeper view.

items.title: Plug in after every ride
items.line: One tap starts the charge timer; the small pill sets when to tell you.

full: Battery % no longer jumps between 100 and 99.
A ride with real GPS distance is never thrown away; Restore discarded ride in Rides.
Ride start and end battery use settled readings: no more 99 % → 100 %.
A ride ends at your last movement; short stops still count in its time.
Auto-started rides begin at your first real riding movement.
Legs to the same destination become one ride, with ↻ Continue to … when you did not arrive.
Bad scooter readings are trimmed, never the whole ride, and trust comes back by itself.
A ride is not ended while the scooter is on or you are moving.
Riding to Uni, 8 km: the destination is said when you set off; change it at a stop.
Pick your destination from the Scooter on notification.
Never two rows for the same place in Where to?.
Arrival times in Where to? are always current.
Destinations show time and battery: Home • 30 mins • 27% battery.
The quick dial is always on Home.
Hold a place to drag it into a new order; let go for its menu.
The › in the Places list sits inside its card.
No parked pin on Home's map.
Shared energy track: battery use spread along the ride by power.
Map layers Speed · Hills · Wind · Battery · Temp, tap again for a deeper view, stops as dots.
The route is one smooth gradient line.
The ride summary map takes about half the screen.
The route draws itself smoothly after a ride.
Drag the ride card like Apple Maps, down to a small lip.
Plug in after every ride: one tap, an alert you choose, an honest time.
One clear Stats chart with km, rides, time or ₪ saved.
Insights show how far along they are; sure ones get their own page.
One ride graph with chips, linked to the map, with a scatter view.
Version names like 101.251026.00 everywhere.
This card: what is new after each update.
